name: blender-band
description: A Blender side panel for Claude Code: running headless jobs with frame and sample progress and who started them, GPU/CPU temperature and load, RAM and disk, and a live preview of the newest render, frame sequence or video. Gives Claude a blender_status tool to check on or wait for a render.

outputsDir.title: Outputs folders
outputsDir.description: Where your renders and videos land, searched six levels deep for the newest picture, frame sequence or video. Several folders separated by ';'; '~' is your home folder. Empty: the session's folder (unless it is your home folder), plus every folder a running Blender saves into, remembered across sessions.

hotWarnC.title: GPU warning temperature (C)
hotWarnC.description: The GPU reading turns yellow 6 C below this and red at it, with a toast.

lowRamPercent.title: Low RAM warning (% of total)
lowRamPercent.description: Available RAM below this share of the total turns yellow.

minDiskGB.title: Low disk warning (GB)
minDiskGB.description: Free disk space below this turns red.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the panel reads processes, logs and sensors.

openOnJob.title: Open the panel when a job starts
openOnJob.description: Opens the Blender panel when a new Blender process appears.

openOnStart.title: Open the panel when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Opens the Blender panel in every new session, Blender running or not.

wrapperScripts.title: Your Blender wrapper scripts
wrapperScripts.description: Names of scripts you run Blender through (resource limits, thermal guards, queues), separated by ';', e.g. render.sh;blender_job.sh. When set, a Bash call of Claude's that runs the blender binary headless itself is refused and pointed at them. Empty: no guard.
